firm_data.firm_description: Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP is a law firm that provides legal services, advocacy, and business strategies under one roof. They are a multidisciplinary, integrated national professional services firm known for quality and an extraordinary commitment to clients.
notable_facts: Unique integrated legal and consulting model

managing_partner.name: Donna L. Wilson
managing_partner.title: Chief Executive Officer and Managing Partner

email.subject: AI for Manatt, Phelps & Phillips, LLP. Built for integrated firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Kristan,

Manatt's integrated legal and consulting model sets you apart from traditional BigLaw, but it also creates unique operational demands across 739 attorneys. I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built specifically for firms balancing complexity, client trust, and efficiency at scale.

We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of practices like yours: precision work without the bloat, seamless coordination across practice areas, and zero compromise on client relationships.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in LA to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office on Thursday, April 10 to share how ex-lawyers are helping similar firms stay competitive.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
